rendered:
The strain is R82[1], derived from Wang et al. evolved strain SDSPY-[2]136 for 120 generations under high osmotic pressure[3] (the strain is listed in the text as tolerant strain R82.[4]).

How it was obtained: adaptive laboratory evolution for improved osmotic tolerance.[5]

Titer and scale: the text states that In 5 L fed-batch fermentation[6], R82 reached 11.4 g[7] per litre of prodigiosin (~double the original strain[8]). The product table gives the same titer, 11,400[9] mg/L, but lists the cultivation mode as shake flask[10] with a time of 48[11] h and reference [18][12].

So the document is internally inconsistent on the fermentation scale: the text describes a fed-batch run at 5 L[13] scale, while the table records a shake-flask culture for the same titer.
